snippet.title: Shipolis - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description: Take a look at the Shipolis announcement trailer for the upcoming cozy minimalist city builder and resource management game where you explore unknown archipelagos with a ship and hopes of glory! Sail the seas, develop your cities, grow your population, set up production lines and collect tons of resources. How many great wonders will you build? Shipolis will be available on PC in 2027.
